ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: The Rot
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
THEROT_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 — absorbs mandrake.rut.rotsporekit (151 files, the Rot's biome mechanics kit) and the RUT_TheRot BiomeDef into their own standalone RimMandrake-tier mod: a pale fungal night-side biome, fully generalized so it names no campaign or franchise and is playable on any generated RimWorld planet. The frozen campaign world's own RUT_TheRot instance is unaffected and unrelated; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it. All Star Wars fauna (the 11 `RSW_` rows the twin's roster carries) ride a Utinni campaign patch (`WildAnimals_TheRot.xml`) instead of this def, per owner ruling Q12/Q11a (`design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md` §7) — a `RM_` biome mod may never hard-name a Star Wars IP creature.
Ships the nine kit mechanics already built and shipped in mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards / mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors, wired onto this biome's own defs: the Sheen exposure weather ladder, accelerated rot/decay, warm living ground, living food-preparation heat, health sharing between kin, guardian groves (defended tea-source mushrooms), the pale tree door-ajar spawn, and the spore-cloud incident. Two terrains (`RM_TheRotGrass`, `RM_TheRotSoilRich`) are this mod's own — donor Alpha Biomes terrains are no longer referenced for the natural ground. Two allergy diseases and thirteen flora stay MayRequire'd on `sarg.alphabiomes` per the Q9 donor-content shape (porting them to our own tier rides `DONOR_DEFS_PORT_TO_OURS_1`, not this build); eight fauna rows stay MayRequire'd on `sarg.alphaanimals` for the same reason.
Live proof is OWED at publish time — see the item's own step 5.
